# Backend verification: partner + gateway / vendor

- Source UI revision / SA revision: 2 / 1 (**approved** 2026-10-15)
- Approved API/schema/authorization references: none yet. Planned against [API](api-contract.md), [database](database-diagram.md), [authorization](authorization.md), [errors](error-handling.md)

No test runner is installed (no Vitest/Jest). Method is the one that verified customer: partner/gateway
`typecheck`, `lint`, `build`; scripted `fetch` checks inside the dev Compose network (direct partner calls with the
service token, and gateway tRPC through `/api/trpc` with real sessions); SQL via `psql` in the postgres container.
Test rows use the prefix `BTVEN` and are deleted afterwards. Grants added for a test user are removed afterwards.
Destructive or shared-data checks (seeding thousands of rows, scratch databases, stopping containers) run only when
the parent selects them; otherwise they are recorded as not run.

## Results — backend run 2026-10-15 (branch `feat/14-10-26-vendor`)

Approval: SA revision 1 + ADR-0019 revision 1, owner 2026-10-15T11:00+07:00 "อนุมัติ ADR-0019 และ SA vendor rev 1".
Environment found: the running dev stack (created 2026-10-12) has no `backend-api-partner` container, `.env` has no
`PARTNER_SERVICE_TOKEN`, and the dev DB had no `partner` schema. Method (same as the customer run): a verification dev
image built from `docker/dev.Dockerfile` (current lockfile); ad-hoc partner and gateway containers on `f1-system_default`
with a random 48-character token (never printed; compared by grep only), source bind-mounted, isolated
`node_modules`/Prisma volumes (the stack's volumes untouched), compiled with `tsc` to `/tmp/dist`; scripted `fetch` checks
run inside the partner container (direct calls with the token, gateway tRPC with real sessions signed in at
`backend-api-auth`), SQL via `pg`/`psql`. The image snapshot of the **pre-change** source gave a customer baseline.
Test rows used `BTVEN`/`BTCUS` prefixes and were deleted (final counts: vendor 0, vendor_address 0, customer 0,
customer_address 0); the temporary grant change for BT-VEN-11 was restored and compared. All ad-hoc containers, volumes
and images were removed. Scripts: vendor 75/75 pass, customer regression 79/79 (three runs: baseline, after BE-VEN-001,
final), BT-VEN-14 7/7. No corrective pass was used.
